Q: q.frame.you
I coordinate the plots for a small community garden.
Q: q.frame.goal
Our goal is a shared harvest that feeds every member household.
Q: q.people.key
The bed steward waters and weeds one bed each week.
The plot coordinator keeps the harvest log up to date and runs the watering rota.
A volunteer lead helps the plot coordinator on weekends.
Q: q.data.where
The harvest log is a paper notebook kept in the tool shed.
Watering happens every morning before nine, checked against the rain gauge by the gate.
